searchText: I am a bit confused with 4-byte long container size. Should we expect it to be greater then `max_initcode_size`? We expect the limits to increase over 64KB. Still a bit confused, but makes more sense now. I just don't get... if we increase container size, shouldn't we change `max_initcode_size` as well? or does it only happen when we append data to data section or something like that? max_initcode_size will need to increase as well. This is a missing detail in the current leading container size increase EIP (because it depended on another EIP that uncapped initcode size, which was rejected for security reasons) Okay, I think I understood, but it’s just me thinking that I understood 😉
